data.name: Obscurity State
data.detailed_description:
The marauders main goal is to find a way out of this strange and dangerous place. The hunters have a different objective: turn as many maradeurs as possible into their own kind and prevent the rest from escaping.

With every new session, the city streets change. A familiar route may disappear, while a road that once led to safety might take you somewhere entirely different the next time. In the thick fog, you never know what awaits around the next corner.

You can rely on your friends. But remember: even if you travel together, your goals may not always align. And what helps one person escape may cost another their freedom.

Use a lighter and a fuel canister to light your way and burn everything and everyone that stands between you and your goal, because sometimes the only way to survive is to leave behind only ashes.

Every word or sound you make can give you away. Hunters can hear you. Keep this in mind when choosing your tactics.

The toolkit of sound devices that you can buy in the game store can be very useful in the fight against all enemies.

data.short_description: "Obscurity State" is an asymmetric co-op horror game for up to 8 players. Escape an ever-changing city as a Marauder, burning everything in your path, or become a supernatural Hunter and track your friends by sound. Remember: your teammates’ goals may not align with yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit 64bit OS required
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 1080p: Geforce GTX 1650, Radeon RX 5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, Keyboard, Microphone for team communication

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit 64bit OS required
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11
